scripts.build: (node -e "process.exit(process.env.TURBO_HASH ? 0 : 1)" || pnpm -w all //#gen) && pnpm --dir ../../vendor/eliza --filter @elizaos/cloud --filter @repo/design-system run build && pnpm --dir ../../vendor/eliza --filter @elizaos/cloud-worker run build && vibelang -p tsconfig.json && pnpm run bundle:worker
scripts.bundle:worker: esbuild dist/src/worker.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --conditions=workerd --conditions=worker --external:cloudflare:* --external:pg-native --banner:js="import { createRequire as __graceCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __graceCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/bundle/worker.mjs
scripts.dev:cf: pnpm build && ALCHEMY_FAST_DISTILLED=1 alchemy --fast-distilled dev --config alchemy.run.ts
scripts.bundle: pnpm build && bundle() { VITE_GRACE_CLOUD_API_ORIGIN="$2" VITE_GRACE_CLOUD_WEB_ORIGIN="$3" pnpm --filter @repo/app build --outDir "../cloud/.wrangler/assets/$1" --emptyOutDir && cp -R ../../vendor/eliza/packages/cloud-worker/dist/pages/. ".wrangler/assets/$1/" && wrangler deploy --env "$1" --dry-run --outdir ".wrangler/bundle/$1"; } && bundle staging https://api-staging.graceforseniors.com https://app-staging.graceforseniors.com && bundle production https://api.graceforseniors.com https://app.graceforseniors.com
scripts.deploy: pnpm bundle && pnpm --filter @repo/app test:browser test/browser.browser.test.tsx -t 'Browse and return to the page I left' && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.deploy:plan: pnpm build && ALCHEMY_FAST_DISTILLED=1 alchemy --fast-distilled plan --config alchemy.run.ts --adopt
scripts.deploy:alchemy: pnpm bundle && ALCHEMY_FAST_DISTILLED=1 alchemy --fast-distilled deploy --config alchemy.run.ts --adopt --yes --no-input
